desc: Parse N and compute for each digit length d (1..6) the count c_d, value sum V_d modulo MOD, and weight w_d=10^d modulo MOD.
Precompute modular inverses and factorial weights W_k = k!(N-1-k)! modulo MOD.
Build R(t)=prod_active(1+w_d t) and B(t)=sum_active c_d*w_d*prod_{e!=d}(1+w_e t) as small polynomials.
Compute coefficients p[0..N] of P(t)=prod_active(1+w_d t)^{c_d} using the logarithmic-derivative recurrence.
For each active d, synthetically divide P by (1+w_d t) to get q_k and add V_d * sum_{k=0}^{N-1} q_k W_k to the answer.
Print answer modulo MOD and verify against samples 3, 390, and 79223.
